panels.title: GPU Temperature (GUESSED metric name — verify before trusting)
panels.description: Uses nvidia_smi_temperature_gpu, which was never observed on a running nvidia_gpu_exporter — see appliances/gb10/deploy/observability-verification.md. If this panel shows 'No data', the real metric name differs; check the exporter's own /metrics output and fix this query plus prometheus/alert-rules.yml together. Measured operating range on this box (nvidia-smi direct, 2026-09-29): idle ~40-51C, load ~62C.

panels.title: vLLM KV Cache Usage
panels.description: Confirmed live metric (vllm:kv_cache_usage_perc, gauge, 0-1) as of 2026-09-29. Substitutes for GPU-memory-percentage on this hardware — nvidia-smi reports memory.used/memory.total as N/A on this GB10's unified-memory architecture, so this is the real capacity-ceiling signal (design doc S9.3).

panels.title: Per-Team Spend vs Budget
panels.description: Confirmed live metrics (litellm_spend_metric_total, litellm_remaining_team_budget_metric, litellm_team_max_budget_metric — all labeled by team/team_alias) as of 2026-09-29. D11 makes team membership the access-control boundary, so this is the operator's view of who is close to being cut off.

panels.title: Root Filesystem Free %
panels.description: Standard node_exporter metric names (node_filesystem_avail_bytes / node_filesystem_size_bytes, mountpoint label) — not deployed/observed by this author, but these are long-stable node_exporter conventions. Spot-check the mountpoint label once node-exporter is actually running (see observability-verification.md). Disk was 3.6TB, 4% used (133G), 25GB of that in the HF model cache, as of 2026-09-29.
